status.deviceLost: Mic disconnected — waiting for it to come back
status.fellBack: Your computer is busy, so Sanay switched to the lighter noise filter.
home.ncHint: Removes background noise like traffic, roosters and karaoke.
home.strengthHint: Light keeps your voice the most natural. Strong removes the most noise.
home.pickInApp: In Zoom, Meet or Teams, choose this microphone:
setup.title: Set up Sanay
setup.step1: Step 1 of 3 — Install the virtual mic
setup.step1Body: Sanay sends your cleaned voice to a free “virtual cable”. Zoom, Meet and Teams then use it as your microphone.
setup.installSteps: Download the zip, extract it, right-click VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe → Run as administrator → Install Driver. Then restart your computer.
setup.step2Body: Pick the headset or mic you will speak into. Talk a little — the bar should move.
setup.step3: Step 3 of 3 — Choose Sanay in your meeting app
setup.step3Body: Open the audio settings of Zoom, Google Meet or Teams and select this as the microphone:
setup.step3Hint: Leave the speaker / headphones setting as it is.
test.title: Mic test
test.body: Record 10 seconds, then compare your raw mic with the cleaned voice. The recording stays in memory only and is never saved.
test.headphonesHint: Use earphones for playback so the speakers don’t feed back into the mic.
settings.title: Settings
settings.monitorHint: Plays your cleaned voice in your earphones. Use earphones, not speakers.
settings.privacy: Sanay works fully offline. Your audio never leaves this computer.
web.title: Test your mic — and hear it without the noise
web.subtitle: Free online mic test. See and hear your microphone, then switch on Sanay noise cancellation to hear how you would sound in your interview.
web.privacy: Everything runs inside your browser. Your voice is never uploaded or saved.
web.allowHint: Your browser will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.
web.err.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Click the mic or lock icon in the address bar, allow the microphone, then try again.
web.err.notFound: No microphone found. Plug in your headset or mic and try again.
web.err.busy: Your mic is being used by another app (Zoom, Teams, Discord…) or by Windows. Close that app and try again.
web.err.insecure: The mic test only works on a secure (https://) page.
web.err.unsupported: This browser can't run the mic test. Please use a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
web.verdict.silent: We can't hear anything. Check that the right mic is selected and not muted.
web.verdict.quiet: Your mic is working but very quiet. Move it closer to your mouth.
web.verdict.good: Your mic is working — you sound good!
web.verdict.loud: Too loud: your voice is clipping. Move the mic a little further away.
web.listenHint: Wear earphones first, or you'll get feedback. There is a small delay.
web.agcHint: Keeps your voice at a steady level, like the desktop app.
web.compareBody: Record up to 1 minute with your usual background noise, then listen to both versions.
web.ai.title: AI voice (local voice server)
web.ai.needNatural: Set the voice type to Natural and record again: the AI voice converts your cleaned natural voice.
web.ai.infoOk: Your pitch {you} Hz → {target} Hz · {ms} ms per 100 ms block: fast enough for a live call.
web.ai.infoSlow: Your pitch {you} Hz → {target} Hz · {ms} ms per 100 ms block: too slow for a live call on this computer.
web.info.name: Device
web.how1Body: Cheap earphones, USB headsets, laptop mics — the cleaning is done in software.
web.how2Body: Tricycles, roosters, karaoke, rain on the roof, electric fans.
web.how3Body: Your audio is processed on your own device. Nothing is uploaded.
web.desktop: Use Sanay in Zoom, Meet and Teams
web.desktopBody: This page is a preview. The Windows app gives Zoom, Meet and Teams a clean Sanay microphone, with a floating on/off pill you can reach mid-call.
web.footer: Sanay. Not affiliated with any call app.
web.voiceHint: Natural keeps your own voice (with Clarity boost for crisper words). Masculine and Feminine change both your pitch and your voice size, the two things people hear as a man’s or a woman’s voice, plus studio-style polish. Use Intensity to dial it back.
status.fallback: Your headset isn’t connected, so Sanay is using {name} for now. It will switch back as soon as you plug it in.
web.fallback: Your selected mic isn’t available, so we switched to {name}. We’ll switch back when you plug it in.
web.fallbackUnplugged: Your mic was unplugged, so we switched to {name}. We’ll switch back when you plug it in.
web.defaultMicHint: No headset? No problem. Sanay works with your laptop or phone’s built-in mic too.
web.voiceCardBody: Choose how you want to sound on the call. Natural keeps your voice; Masculine and Feminine give you a professional voice that still sounds human.
web.noiseLimit: Sanay removes steady and engine noise (fans, traffic, tricycles, rain) very well. Other people talking nearby (TV, neighbours) is much harder for any noise filter, so move away from them if you can.
web.voice.masculineDesc: Deep & crisp: a deep, confident professional man’s voice with a fuller chest and clear words.
web.voice.feminineDesc: Light & clear: a clear, polished professional woman’s voice, with no rumble underneath.
web.clarityHint: Makes your natural voice crisper and easier to understand (less muddy, clearer words, softer “s” sounds).
air.onBodyNatural: Your own voice · noise cleanup on
air.offBody: The call hears your normal mic
air.fallback: The AI voice couldn't start, so the basic {voice} voice is on. Close Chrome tabs or other heavy apps; it keeps trying by itself.
air.hint: Click the orb, or the floating pill, to switch.
voice.title: Your voice
pill.help: Click to switch on or off. Drag to move. Right-click to open Sanay.
settings.pillHint: Stays on top of your call so you can switch Sanay on or off anytime.
english.title: Say it in English
english.body: Speak in Filipino or Taglish. Read the English out in your own voice.
english.noVoice: Voice typing works in Chrome. You can type below.
english.listening: Listening… tap again when you're done
english.said: You said (you can fix or type it)
english.placeholder: e.g. Pasensya na po, ichecheck ko lang kung nasaan na yung order ninyo.
english.readTip: Read it slowly, in your own voice. Tap Hear it first if you're unsure how to say it.
english.privacy: Free, no account needed. Voice typing uses Chrome's speech recognition, which sends your audio to Google. The text is translated by MyMemory, a free translation service. Sanay saves nothing.
english.err.offline: No internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
english.err.limit: Today's free translations are used up on this connection. Try again tomorrow.
english.err.empty: Sanay couldn't turn that into English. Try saying it another way.
english.err.not-allowed: Sanay needs your microphone. Allow it in Chrome's address bar, then try again.
english.err.no-speech: Didn't hear anything. Tap the mic and speak a little louder.
english.err.audio-capture: No microphone found. Plug one in, or type instead.
english.err.network: Voice typing needs internet. Check your connection, or type instead.
english.err.other: Something went wrong. Try again, or type it instead.
air.blockedBody: Not reaching your call yet: see above
air.liveBody: Noise cleanup on · the call hears this voice
web.hero.title: Sound clear on every call.
web.hero.body: Sanay removes background noise and can give you a masculine or feminine AI voice, live in Zoom, Meet and Teams. Try it on your own voice, right here.
web.hero.orbHint: Press Test your voice, then talk. The light follows you.
web.lab.title: Your voice lab
web.lab.body: Hear your mic raw and cleaned, record and compare, and preview the AI voices. It all runs in your browser.
web.desktop.pillCaption: The floating pill stays on top of your call: click to switch, drag to move.
theme.title: Appearance
auth.stage.signup: Your account keeps your voice and settings, ready for the desktop app.
auth.stage.login: Welcome back. Your voice is right where you left it.
auth.signup.title: Create your account
auth.signup.body: One account for the Sanay app and the website.
auth.step2.title: Make it yours
auth.step2.body: Pick the voice Sanay starts with. You can change everything later.
auth.login.title: Log in
auth.login.body: Use the email and password you signed up with.
auth.name: Full name
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Longer is stronger.
auth.demo: Preview: accounts are saved only in this browser for now. Passwords are stored as secure hashes, never as typed.
auth.err.name: Enter your name.
auth.err.email_taken: That email already has an account. Log in instead.
auth.err.bad_credentials: That email and password don't match.
auth.err.too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
auth.err.not_signed_in: Your session ended. Log in again.
account.title: Your account
account.sanayBody: The voice Sanay starts with and what you use it for.
account.planBody: Sanay is in personal testing. Plans are not decided yet; your account and settings will carry over when they are.
account.planItem2: Masculine and Feminine AI voices, running on your own computer
account.planItem3: Browser voice lab: test, record and compare
account.securityBody: Change your password or delete your account.
account.deleteBody: Permanently removes your account and settings.
account.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your account and settings. It can't be undone. Enter your password to confirm.
account.tab.overview.body: Your voice, your setup, and what to do next.
account.tab.preferences.body: How Sanay sounds and looks for you.
account.tab.devices.body: Computers where you use the Sanay app.
account.tab.security.body: Your password, your session, and your account.
account.tab.practice.body: Talk with a practice partner out loud, then get your score and tips.
account.tab.english.body: Say it in Filipino or Taglish. Read the English out in your own voice.
account.tab.coach.body: Short drills for the sounds that are easy to mix up.
account.setup.title: Get ready for your first call
account.devices.body: When the Sanay desktop app is released, sign in on your computer and it will appear here, so you can see where your account is used.
account.appearanceBody: Follow Windows, or always use light or dark.
account.sessionBody: Sign out of Sanay on this browser.
statusPage.error.title: Something went wrong
statusPage.error.body: Sanay hit an unexpected problem. Reloading usually fixes it. Your account and settings are safe.
statusPage.maintenance.title: Sanay is getting an update
statusPage.maintenance.body: We're improving things behind the scenes. Please check back shortly.
guide.title: User guide
guide.body: Everything you need to sound clear on your calls, from installing the virtual microphone to fixing common problems.
guide.stuck.title: Still stuck?
guide.stuck.body: Test your microphone and the voices right in your browser. It shows what your mic picks up and how Sanay cleans it.
account.guide.calls.body: Zoom, Meet, Teams and Discord, step by step.
account.guide.pill.body: Switch on and off without leaving your call.
account.guide.help.body: Quick fixes when something sounds wrong.
account.next.cable.body: It carries Sanay's voice into Zoom, Meet or Teams. It's free from VB-Audio and takes a few minutes.
account.next.app.body: The app runs your voice live during calls. It's coming soon; we'll show it here when it's ready.
account.next.call.body: Choose CABLE Output as the microphone in your call app and switch Sanay on.
settings.echoHint: Removes what your speakers play from your mic, so the other person never hears themselves. Works with any mic. Paused while you hear yourself.
pv.title: The new screens, inside the Sanay app
pv.body: Click through each screen. Nothing here is recorded or scored yet; it shows how the features will look and feel.
pv.s.home.note: The app you know, plus new doors: Practice a call and Filipino subtitles.
pv.s.pick.note: Situation packs: Jobs & BPO, OFW and Students, from easy to hard.
pv.s.call.note: The orb is the other person. Live captions, mute, hang up. Turn by turn.
pv.s.score.note: Right after the call: a Ready score, what went well, and weak moments to replay.
pv.s.english.note: This one works for real: tap the mic, speak Filipino or Taglish, and get English to read out.
pv.s.coach.note: Short drills for sounds Filipinos often mix up, explained in Taglish.
pv.s.notice.note: Shown once before the masculine or feminine voice is used on a real call.
pv.s.subtitles.note: During a real call, the other person's English appears in Filipino.
pv.home.onBody: Your calls hear the clean voice
pv.home.practiceSub: A practice partner plays the other person
pv.home.subtitlesSub: See what they say, in Filipino
pv.sit.late.sub: A customer's order is 5 days late
pv.sit.bank.sub: Double charge on a credit card
pv.pick.title: Who will you talk to?
pv.pick.body: Pick a situation. You can stop anytime.
pv.pick.foot: About 3 minutes. Use earphones for the best practice.
pv.call.tip: Tip: say sorry first, then ask for one thing.
pv.score.feedback: Your apology was great. Next: slow down a bit when you give the solution.
pv.score.m1.fix: Try: “Let me check that for you right now.”
pv.coach.body: Two minutes a day. From your last call: practice V / B.
pv.coach.tip: For “V”, rest your top teeth on your lower lip. For “B”, just your lips, like “ba”.
pv.notice.title: Before you use a different voice
pv.notice.body: The voice option is for comfort and confidence. Please use it fairly.
pv.notice.r1: Your words, your ideas: only the sound of the voice changes.
pv.notice.r2: Preset voices only. Sanay never copies a real person's voice.
pv.notice.r3: Never use it to pretend to be someone else, or for ID checks or bank calls.
pv.notice.r4: If someone asks, be honest that you use a voice tool.
pv.sub.title: Filipino subtitles
pv.sub.fil: “Puwede mo bang ikuwento ang huli mong trabaho?”
practice.setup.title: Ready to practice?
practice.setup.body: Talk with a practice partner, out loud, like a real interview. You'll get your score and tips at the end.
practice.voice.title: Your interviewer's voice
practice.setup.tip1: Use earphones if you can, so the interviewer's voice doesn't go into your mic.
practice.setup.tip2: Find a quiet spot. When it's your turn, just talk. Tap “I'm done” when you finish.
practice.privacy: Free, no account needed. Chrome's speech recognition sends your voice to Google to write down your words. Your recordings stay on this device and disappear when you leave the page.
practice.choose.title: What interview are you preparing for?
practice.state.listening: Your turn. Go ahead and answer.
practice.err.browser: The practice interview needs Chrome on a computer or Android phone. Please open Sanay in Chrome.
practice.err.mic: Sanay needs your microphone. Click the mic or lock icon in the address bar, allow the microphone, then try again.
practice.err.network: Voice typing needs internet. Check your connection, then try again.
practice.strength.length: your answers had a good length.
practice.strength.pace: you spoke at a clear pace.
practice.advice.silent: Try to answer every question, even with a short answer.
practice.advice.short: Give longer answers, with one example each time.
practice.advice.long: Keep your answers a little shorter, about one minute each.
practice.advice.fast: You spoke fast ({pace} words a minute). Slow down a little and pause between ideas.
practice.advice.slow: You spoke slowly ({pace} words a minute). Try to keep going.
practice.advice.fillers: You said “{word}” {count} times. A short pause is better than a filler word.
practice.advice.pauses: There were {count} long pauses. Plan your answer in your head first.
practice.advice.start: You waited about {seconds} seconds before answering. You can say “Let me think” and then begin.
practice.advice.content: Cover more of the key points. Check the tip under each answer.
coach.result.other: That sounded like the other word.
coach.done.good: Good job! Practice it once more to get them all.
coach.done.more: Keep going. Read the tip, listen, then try again. It gets easier.
coach.err.browser: Pronunciation practice needs Chrome on a computer or Android phone.
coach.err.noSpeech: We didn't hear anything. Tap Say it, then say the word clearly.
coach.err.mic: Sanay needs your microphone. Allow it in the address bar, then try again.
coach.err.network: This needs internet. Check your connection, then try again.
coach.privacy: Free. Chrome's speech recognition sends your voice to Google to check the word. Your progress stays on this device.
voiceNotice.title: Before you use a different voice
voiceNotice.body: The voice option is for comfort and confidence. Please use it fairly.
voiceNotice.r1: Your words, your ideas: only the sound of the voice changes.
voiceNotice.r2: Preset voices only. Sanay never copies a real person's voice.
voiceNotice.r3: Never use it to pretend to be someone else, or for ID checks or bank calls.
voiceNotice.r4: If someone asks, be honest that you use a voice tool.
voiceNotice.reminder: Reminder: use the voice option fairly. If someone asks, be honest that you use a voice tool.
account.practiceNow.body: Practice out loud, fix the words you're unsure of, and say it right in English.
english.empty: Your English will show here, ready to read out loud.
practice.answerWait: Your words will appear here when it's your turn.
coach.listen.body: First, train your ear. When you can hear the difference, it's easier to say it right.
coach.listen.wrong: Not quite. The word was “{word}”. Play it again and listen closely.
coach.listen.great: Great ear! You can hear the difference.
coach.listen.ok: Good start. The more you listen, the easier it gets.
coach.listen.next: Now try saying the words yourself.
coach.triesLeft: Read the tip, tap Hear it, then say “{word}” again. Tries left: {n}.
coach.noMoreTries: That's all the tries for this word. It's okay; we'll practice it again later.
coach.sentence.title: Sentence challenge
coach.sentence.body: Now put it together. Say the whole sentence at a normal pace.
coach.sentence.score: {n} of {total} key words came out clear.
practice.statsNoPace: {words} words · pace not measured (try a quieter spot)
practice.nothingToFix: Nothing big to fix. Practice another interview type to stay sharp.
